reviews.comment: You really can't wish more from him. He's smart, professional, and funny. If he taught another undergraduate course, I would take it in a heartbeat.

Considering how difficult the course content can be at times, Dr. Wang makes this class manageable. The tests are graded with very generous partial credit, the overall class is graded often on a strong curve if needed, and he genuinely cares about teaching. He is very transparent in what we should expect on exams.

STAT 414 is the hardest class for stat major. Dr Wang is SO fair. He allows cheat sheets for exams, plus bonus questions. Past exams & solutions are given and similar to the exam. For our 2nd exam, average was 30 and allowed test corrections for 75% of points back AND went over the answers IN CLASS. Go to class, go to office hours, you'll get an A.

Very genuine - cares about his students and does everything he can to help you succeed. Practice tests tend to prepare you for exams pretty well and homeworks are usually more difficult than exams. It's a difficult subject, attendance is strongly recommended to know what's going on, but he does his best to break it down for you.

One of the best profs at A&M, take him!! Such a nice guy and a good lecturer. Attendance isn't required but he makes class fun. He curves all the tests and an 85 is an A in the class. Homework once a week, 2 tests and a cumulative final. You get to use cheat sheets on the test. Would highly recommend Wang!!

Professor Wang is fantastic. He is very attentive to students' needs; if anybody is confused, he always takes the time to work with that student one-on-one, ensuring that they're caught up. Grading is a joke; 85+ is an A in the course, and every single test is curved such that 85 is the average.
STAT 414 is a hard and boring class which the professor agrees to as well. However, he explains well and is nice. I wish he taught stat 415. Amazing prof.

Dr. Wang is an amazing lecturer. He takes the time to explain concepts deeply, but you should ask him questions so you make sure you understand- the material isn't easy. His tests are hard, so you should study a lot and make good cheatsheets, but he curves generously. After taking his class, you will truly know about statistics. Highly recommend!

reviews.comment:
Attendance isn't graded, so I said not mandatory, but don't miss class! He posts his lecture slides, but without class attendance, it's just example problems with no solutions. He only posts the filled out lecture slides the day or two before the exam!
The class itself isn't hard, and you get cheat sheets for exams. Homeworks are worse than exams.
